title: Bar chart race
what_it_does: Ranked bars grow and overtake each other over a time series; axis rescales and the accent follows the leader. Data, title and periods are editable variables.
when_to_use: Showing how a ranking changed over time (market share, subscribers, scores).
why: Official block, 10 variables, installs with `hyperframes add bar-chart-race`; fills the chart-race slot nothing else covers.
